sources.title: Broncos Country foresees prolific passing from Nix
sources.description: As a rookie, Bo Nix threw for 3,775 yards. Last year, he slung it just shy of 4,000 yards. In year three, Broncos Country predicts its young QB will break the 4,000-yard barrier, but perhaps just barely.
